document.title: Releasing sxml
document.p: How a release is cut. Agents prepare a release up to its release commit, a workflow tags and publishes it from that commit, and the owner approves the npm package (). The first public release is 0.2.0, made at the end of Phase 2 (PLAN.md, phase 2 gate).

section.title: What a version promises
section.p: sxml follows Semantic Versioning (include/sxml/version.h). The public headers (include/sxml/) are stable from 0.2.0 on ():

item.p: A release that only adds declarations raises the minor version (the patch version for fixes that add nothing). It also raises SXML_API_VERSION to the release that added them.

A release that changes or removes a declaration needs a decision record in docs/DECISIONS.md. Before 1.0.0 it raises the minor version, and from 1.0.0 the major version. The changelog lists the change under "Changed" or "Removed".
The frozen substrate headers () change only additively, and each change has a record.
xquery.h, xslt.h and schema.h were provisional until the Phase 3, 4 and 5 gates (, ) and are stable since (, , ).

section.p: The JavaScript package (bindings/javascript/) has the same version as the library. Its API grows only additively within a minor version, as the headers do.

item.p: Gate. The phase gate's boxes in docs/tasks/ are ticked, except the box for the tag.
Version. Set the same version in four places:
SXML_VERSION_MAJOR, _MINOR and _PATCH in include/sxml/version.h, and SXML_API_VERSION when the release adds declarations;
the expected version in tests/version_test.c, tests/cli/expected/version_*.stdout and bindings/javascript/test/package.test.ts.
Changelog. In CHANGELOG.md, the section for the release gets the date in place of "unreleased", and its link at the bottom names the tag.
Build and test from a clean tree. The definition of done (CLAUDE.md) must hold:
item.pre: for preset in debug wasm release; do cmake --preset $preset && cmake --build --preset $preset && ctest --preset $preset done tools/lint.sh npm ci --prefix bindings/javascript && ctest --preset wasm -R javascript
item.p: javascript/size_budget must pass (, ). Regenerate docs/CONFORMANCE.md () and quote its XP40 line in the release notes.
Commit the version and the changelog as "Release X.Y.Z", then push to main.

Tag and GitHub release (.github/workflows/release.yml, no computer needed). The push of the commit "Release X.Y.Z" starts it: when no tag vX.Y.Z exists, it tags that commit (sxml X.Y.Z), makes the GitHub release vX.Y.Z with the version's section of CHANGELOG.md as its notes (tools/release-notes.sh X.Y.Z), starts npm.yml for the tag (step 7), and builds and attaches the sxml archives with SHA256SUMS (mise run dist), then publishes sxml.tinyactors.dev from the release commit (site.yml, ). The run's summary links the release. "Run workflow" on release.yml with a version does the steps again for that version, for a run that failed.

Publish the JavaScript package. release.yml starts .github/workflows/npm.yml () for the tag (a tag pushed by hand starts it too), which runs tools/npm-package.sh publish: it builds the package from the tag, runs its tests (ctest javascript/*), packs it, installs the tarball into a fresh project as a check and stages it on npm with trusted publishing. The owner then approves the staged version with 2FA: npmjs.com, the package, Staged Packages; or npm stage list @tinyactors/sxml and npm stage approve ID. To build and check the tarball without publishing, run mise run npm:pack -- vX.Y.Z; it lands in build/npm/vX.Y.Z/. A run that failed, or a tag older than the workflow, is published with "Run workflow" on npm.yml and the tag.

Before pushing the release commit, check the package's trusted publisher on npmjs.com (the package, Settings): GitHub Actions, tinyactors-dev/sxml, workflow npm.yml, no environment, npm stage publish only. npm drops a new one that no publish validates within two days, so one set up after a release has expired by the next: delete it and add it again, and the release's run validates it.
The npm name sxml belongs to another project. The package is named @tinyactors/sxml ().
After the release, open a new "unreleased" section in CHANGELOG.md.
